allowed_pre_run_claims: CertGen implements a design/scaffold for metric-agnostic decision certification.
Clean-core KID/MMD/CMMD-style certificates are implemented or planned, depending on actual code state.
FID is descriptive-only unless rigorously handled.
The project is zero-cost/released-samples-oriented by design.

claims.claim_text: CertGen implements a design scaffold for metric-agnostic decision certification.
Clean-core KID/MMD/CMMD-style certificate scaffolds are implemented for non-evidence validation.
FID and FD-style metrics are descriptive-only unless a separate rigorous audit is added.
The first-benchmark undecided fraction has a numeric value.

forbidden_pre_run_claims: any claim that published wins are undecided
any rigorous FID certificate claim unless audited
any claim that CertGen is a new metric
any claim that FID is useless/wrong
any claim that most papers are wrong
